description: Follow-up to EXP-009 (DEC-013). In mutual mode OpenSSL auto-chaining sends the CA certificate in both directions, whereas AGP/1 sends only end-entity certificates. This run measures in-memory TLS 1.3 handshakes (both parties in one process, no network, same method as the EXP-002 AGP/1 handshake CPU measurement) with the default chains and with leaf-only chains: handshake bytes per direction, received chain lengths and total CPU time. HARDWARE MEASUREMENT on the VM.
